nodes.label: NewDefaultCommand
nodes.desc: Root cobra command; makeBuildCommand wires the build subcommand to stdout.

nodes.label: NewCmdBuild
nodes.desc: Defines flags (--output, --load-restrictor, --enable-helm...) and the RunE body.

nodes.label: MakeDefaultOptions
nodes.desc: Defaults: LoadRestrictionsRootOnly, plugins disabled, ReorderOptionNone.

nodes.label: AsYaml output
nodes.desc: RunE serializes the ResMap with m.AsYaml() or writes individual files via MakeWriter.

nodes.label: MakeKustomizer
nodes.desc: Constructs a Kustomizer holding options and a DepProvider for resource/plugin factories.

nodes.label: Kustomizer.Run
nodes.desc: Creates loader + KustTarget, loads OpenAPI, calls MakeCustomizedResMap, applies sort order.

nodes.label: applySortOrder
nodes.desc: sortOptions in kustomization.yaml wins over the deprecated --reorder flag.

nodes.label: NewLoader
nodes.desc: Detects git URLs (NewRepoSpecFromURL) vs local directories and picks the loader.

nodes.label: FileLoader
nodes.desc: Per-directory loader enforcing root containment; Load fetches file or HTTP content.

nodes.label: newLoaderAtGitClone
nodes.desc: Clones remote bases (ClonerUsingGitExec) into a temp dir, always root-restricted.

nodes.label: RestrictionRootOnly
nodes.desc: LoadRestrictorFunc that forbids loading outside the kustomization root unless relaxed.

nodes.label: KustTarget
nodes.desc: One kustomization build: kustomization struct, loader, validator, resmap.Factory, plugin loader.

nodes.label: Load
nodes.desc: Unmarshals kustomization.yaml, warns on deprecated fields, runs FixKustomization/EnforceFields.

nodes.label: LoadKustFile
nodes.desc: Finds exactly one recognized kustomization file name, else errors (missing or multiple).

nodes.label: MakeCustomizedResMap
nodes.desc: The full build flow: accumulate, add hashes, fix back references, resolve vars, drop locals.

nodes.label: AccumulateTarget
nodes.desc: Starts an empty ResAccumulator and walks resources, configs, generators, components, transformers.

nodes.label: accumulateDirectory
nodes.desc: Recursion step: builds a sub-KustTarget for each base/component and merges its accumulator.

nodes.label: accumulateFile
nodes.desc: Loads a single YAML resource file and appends it with an origin annotation.

nodes.label: runGenerators
nodes.desc: Configures builtin + external generators, then AbsorbAll of each generated ResMap.

nodes.label: runTransformers
nodes.desc: Builtin transformers (with transformer config) plus external ones, applied in one pass.

nodes.label: runValidators
nodes.desc: Runs validator plugins and errors if they mutated the resource map.

nodes.label: addHashesToNames
nodes.desc: Applies the HashTransformer so ConfigMaps/Secrets with changed data get new names.

nodes.label: newMultiTransformer
nodes.desc: Applies each member transformer in order, adding transformer annotations and dropping empties.

nodes.label: ResAccumulator
nodes.desc: Holds resources plus transformer config and vars; everything flows through here.

nodes.label: AbsorbAll
nodes.desc: Merges generator output: union conflict resolution instead of append.

nodes.label: MergeAccumulator
nodes.desc: Merges a child kustomization's accumulator (resources, config, vars) into the parent.

nodes.label: FixBackReferences
nodes.desc: NameReferenceTransformer updates refs like Deployment->Service after renaming.

nodes.label: ResolveVars
nodes.desc: Substitutes legacy var values gathered from accumulated resources.

nodes.label: Factory
nodes.desc: Makes ResMaps from bytes, files, or resource slices using a resource.Factory.

nodes.label: FromFile
nodes.desc: loader.Load(path) then decode bytes into a ResMap.

nodes.label: ResMap
nodes.desc: Interface over resources keyed by ResId: append, merge, transform, AsYaml.

nodes.label: MakeTransformerConfig
nodes.desc: Loads default + user transformer configurations (name references, field specs).

nodes.label: MakeConfigMap
nodes.desc: Built-in configMapGenerator implementation: env files, literals, files.

nodes.label: PrefixTransformerPlugin
nodes.desc: Example builtin transformer: adds name prefix/suffix, respecting skip rules.
